verdict.rationale: LangSmith supports background automations via rules/webhooks, alerts that route to Slack/PagerDuty/HTTP endpoints, and online evaluators that run automatically on live production traces without user intervention (docs-4, docs-10, docs-12/13). It also offers optional 'LangSmith Deployment' to run and manage agents (docs-17), suggesting some autonomous agent execution capability, but this is a secondary/optional feature and detail is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that these automations actually run unattended over time, more detail on scheduling/triggers beyond alerts, and clearer scope of 'LangSmith Deployment' for autonomous agent runs.
